title: Redefining the Year
coreMove: Replace a distant annual horizon with a 12 week execution horizon that makes tradeoffs visible now.
sourcePressure: Annualized thinking weakens urgency because a distant deadline lets focus leak until year-end pressure finally appears.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Treating 12 weeks as a motivational trick or arbitrary productivity sprint rather than a pressure-producing execution frame.

sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: Annualized thinking makes January feel spacious enough to waste and December urgent enough to panic.
